official_sources.name: DEFRA UK PRTR annual download page
facts: annual CSV/XML datasets available back to 2007

official_sources.name: UK PRTR guidance
facts: operator annual emissions are regulator checked
permit cross-reference, inspections and monitoring used for QA
C_ETS method means calculation using ETS monitoring/reporting guidance
facility omission can mean activity or pollutant threshold not met

official_sources.name: PI-3 UK PRTR reporting form
facts: CO2 CAS 124-38-9 air reporting threshold 100000000 kg/year
renewable-fuel CO2 row applies when total CO2 released exceeds 10000000 kg

guards: PRTR CO2 threshold means absence is not evidence of zero emissions.
PRTR releases are not substituted for UK ETS verified emissions without row-level identity and method checks.
No CSV/XLSX value is claimed unless file content is actually consumed.
No England assignment is inferred from a UK-wide source without facility geography.
No parcel binding, browser acceptance, DB write, migration or deployment claim.
No repeated binary-download loop after the verified access failure.
